title: Command Definition Schema
description: Schema for validating Claude Code slash command definitions (.claude/commands/*.md frontmatter)

description.description: Short description of what the command does, shown in /help listings

disable-model-invocation.description: If true, command content is injected directly into context without LLM invocation

allowed-tools.description: Comma-separated list of tools the command is allowed to use

skill.description: Name of the skill this command delegates to

category.description: Command category for organization and discovery
